security_spec.violation_condition: When mpmpdeleg.pmpnum is written with a value <= the index of any locked PMP entry, the RTL's CSR write path in the mpmpdeleg CSR module fails to reject the write (i.e., ignores the lock constraint check), allowing M-mode software to delegate a locked PMP entry for use as an SPMP entry. The locked PMP entry then becomes writable by S-mode via indirect CSR access (siselect/sireg), violating the hardware lock guarantee that locked PMP entries remain immutable until hart reset.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: mpmpdeleg.*pmpnum.*locked|mpmpdeleg write.*lock check|pmpnum WARL.*lock constraint|spmpcfg.*L.*delegation boundary
security_spec.summary: Hardware fails to enforce mpmpdeleg.pmpnum WARL lock constraint: writing pmpnum below a locked PMP entry index is not rejected, allowing S-mode to reconfigure previously locked M-mode PMP entries via SPMP indirect CSR access, breaking the hardware root-of-trust isolation boundary
